translations.web: So then, brothers, stand firm and hold the traditions which you were taught by us, whether by word or by letter.
translations.bsb: Therefore, brothers, stand firm and cling to the traditions we taught you, whether by speech or by letter.
translations.kjv: Therefore, brethren, stand fast, and hold the traditions which ye have been taught, whether by word, or our epistle.
translations.asv: So then, brethren, stand fast, and hold the traditions which ye were taught, whether by word, or by epistle of ours.
